children: On September 17, 2026, the company received notice from Nasdaq that it failed to meet the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement under Listing Rule 5450(a)(1) after 30 consecutive business days below $1. Hyperfine has 180 days, until March 16, 2027, to regain compliance by maintaining a closing bid of at least $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days; its shares continue to trade on the Nasdaq Global Market under HYPR.
